findings.finding: Substantial execution of written v0.3 is documented. This is not evidence of faithful replication of the historical successful manual execution.

RUN_013 recorded manual execution without context isolation or formal construction closure and reuse of RUN_012 section 43.5. RUN_014 introduced a fresh isolated expression context and a frozen graph.

The expression voice packet contained 34 spoken excerpts totaling 388 whitespace words, 5 to 19 words each. All were unvalidated for writing; no complete author-validated written passage was supplied. There were 18 candidate rules: 17 unconfirmed and 1 provisional.
findings.certainty: high; counts measured from retained input

findings.finding: The frozen structure contained 110 claims and 32 acts. Audit qualifications entered the prose. Review finding O01 flagged repeated emphasis on audit status; it remained nonblocking and was retained.
Review established source fidelity and record integrity more strongly than authorial voice. Rhetorical and linguistic review occurred, but approval of the voice was not established.

responsibility: The assistant selected the execution conditions and allowed an identified rhetorical concern to remain unresolved. The same procedure and ledger labels were insufficient evidence of execution equivalence.
cause_of_detector_result: unknown; observations above identify execution and review defects, not an isolated causal explanation
corrective_actions_proposed: Retain the failed prose, original prompts, checks and pending evaluation snapshots unchanged; append this result.
Record execution configuration separately from procedure and corpus versions, including actual supplied exemplars and context boundaries.
Recover exact successful prompts and complete passages where available; identify unrecovered items explicitly.
Define and enforce a meaningful rhetorical and linguistic review before a further full chapter is presented as a comparable trial.
Use a small controlled comparison before drawing another full-chapter generalization; freeze changes and preserve all results.
implemented_in_this_followup: Measured and independently audited retained inputs and reviews
Corrected current experiment status without altering the tested text
not_implemented: No new voice rules or corpus promotion
publication_scope: Metadata only; no manuscript passages, source text, or voice excerpt payload.
